openDay: Open this day to ideas again
transferIntro: Have you already arranged the journey in between? A short answer is enough.
transferAssumption: Duration and baggage buffer are your own estimates. This does not make a booking.
bookingsIntro: Review confirmations before they become part of your plan.
noCandidates: No reliable booking details were found. You can enter them manually.
retain: Explicitly keep the original with this trip
aiIntro: A transparent proposal when you ask for one. Fixed bookings remain protected.
aiEnable: Enable AI planning help for this trip
cloudEnable: Also allow cloud providers already configured and consented to
aiConsent: The default permits local providers only. Private notes, booking references and travel documents are not included in the planning context.
request: What would you like help with?
requestExample: Make the arrival day more relaxed and account for transfer buffers. Please explain in English.
stale: This proposal no longer matches the current plan. Please generate it again.
packIntro: Packing help for your destination and plans. Your own quantities are preserved.
weatherUnknown: No forecast is available for this period yet. Missing data does not mean good weather.
unknownCosts: Unknown prices and other currencies are not treated as free.
readyIntro: The same trip and documents. Planning stays separate from actual experiences.
handoverDone: The plan is released and remains editable.
noAutoCount: Releasing a plan confirms no visits. Past plan dates do not automatically count as experiences.
noPush: Hints stay in the app. Intentionally open points stay quiet.

packingIdeas.shoes: Suitable shoes for the hiking idea

parseAI: Use AI to read this document (otherwise templates only)
parseLocal: Document analysis permits a local provider only.
parseCloud: If you enable AI reading, configured and consented cloud providers are also permitted.
linkActualFailed: This trip's records could not be loaded.
locationSource: Location data: Open-Meteo / GeoNames. Search and forecast retrieval only run when you ask.
groupPrice: Total booking price: counted once across all associated segments.
clothingGuide: Prepare clothes for around {{days}} days. Adjust quantities per item.
clothingUnknown: Travel dates help estimate clothing quantities.
packingGuide: Check cabin luggage limits, liquid rules and entry documents with the carrier or responsible authority.

actual.intro: Your plan beside what your recording and your stays say about the trip. The plan is not changed.
actual.noRoute: This plan has no route with stations
actual.noRouteHint: Plan and reality can only be compared for a route with stations.
actual.failed: I could not load the comparison just now
actual.noTrack: There is no recording for this trip. Without a track every station stays open – nothing is counted as skipped.
actual.truncated: The track is incomplete: the source held more points than were read. No station is counted as skipped because of it.
actual.unreachable: The location source could not be reached. The comparison shows only what is known without it.
actual.sketchLabel: Sketch: planned route and actual track
actual.sketchLegend: Dashed: planned route. Solid: actual track.
actual.readOnly: A comparison only: nothing here changes your plan.

deletePlan.staysBody: The trip itself and everything already in the logbook: flights, stays, ferries, stations and photos. A plan is not travel evidence, so deleting one removes none of it.
deletePlan.staysStations: {{count}} station(s) were already taken into the logbook and stay there.
deletePlan.shell: The trip is then only a name and dates. You can delete it separately if you wish.
deletePlan.previewFailed: What would be deleted could not be loaded, so nothing is deleted now.
deletePlan.failed: The plan could not be deleted. Nothing was changed.

overview.handoverBody: Once the trip is over (or a station reached) you take it into the logbook. Until then none of it counts as travelled.

handover.title: Take stations into the logbook
handover.intro: Once a station is reached the plan writes it to the logbook: the stop on the roadtrip, the booked night as a stay and the ferry you arrived on. Open placeholders never become records.
handover.noStations: The plan has no stations yet.
handover.records_one: {{count}} entry written by the plan. Withdrawing deletes only what you have not changed since.
handover.records_other: {{count}} entries written by the plan. Withdrawing deletes only what you have not changed since.
handover.placeholders_one: {{count}} placeholder stays in the plan and is not taken over.
handover.placeholders_other: {{count}} placeholders stay in the plan and are not taken over.

match.title: Matches a placeholder
match.intro: "{{booking}}" looks like the real booking for "{{placeholder}}".
match.inactiveVariant: The placeholder belongs to the alternative route.

members.title: Plan together
members.introOwner: Invite people from this server to plan with you. They may change everything except deleting the plan, managing members and changing the AI setting. Only you confirm into the logbook.
members.introMember: You plan along. You may change everything except deleting the plan, managing members and changing the AI setting. Only you see your packing and your note.
members.sharedDone: {{name}} received the linked copy of the trip.
members.consentNote: Both sides must have allowed sharing with each other (Share trip → Consents).

summary.assign_idea: assigned an idea to a day

members.noteHint: Only you see this note - the other co-planners do not.
members.shareFailed: The linked copy of the trip could not be given to {{names}}. You can retry in the co-planners dialog.

conflictBy: {{name}} has changed the plan in the meantime. Your input is still there - check the current state and save again.
